content.text: Observe Ramadan is a decision available to Muslim adult characters at peace and not being busy.
It cost 100 Wealth, reduces Decadence by 3 and increases Piety by 15.
This event ends early in case of war or sickness.
Will trigger an event in the following table in 3, 10 and 17 days after taking Observe Ramadan decision. these events can only triggers once per Ramadan.
All theses events can result in a choice leading -1 Decadence and +15 Piety, or +1 Decadent and -15 Piety, unless stated otherwise.
